kpis.title: KPI Measurements
kpis.description: Security performance metrics tracked over time. Demonstrates effectiveness per NIS2 Art. 21.
kpis.helpText: Record security KPI measurements regularly (e.g., patch compliance rate, training completion %, mean time to detect). KPIs demonstrate to auditors that your security measures are effective and improving over time.
kpis.empty: No KPI measurements yet. Record your first measurement.

fieldDescriptions.kpiName: Name of the security metric being measured (e.g., 'Patch compliance rate', 'Mean time to detect', 'Training completion %').
fieldDescriptions.measuredAt: Date when this measurement was taken.
fieldDescriptions.value: Enter the measured numeric value for this KPI.
fieldDescriptions.target: Enter the target value this KPI should meet or exceed.
fieldDescriptions.unit: Unit of measurement (e.g., %, hours, days, count).
fieldDescriptions.status: Select the status: green (on target), amber (at risk of missing target), or red (below target).
fieldDescriptions.notes: Additional context or explanation for this measurement, especially if status is amber or red.
